messages:
maya (DevEx): FYI — new org reported the quickstart failing on their first call with 403 / {"error":"billing_required"}. They followed the README exactly after SSO signup.

maya (DevEx): Repro curl they ran: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer rwd_test_zzz" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

cami (Support): That usually means the workspace hasn't been activated for billing (Admins must Accept Billing Terms after SSO). Console shows a banner when that's required.

maya (DevEx): Console screenshot they sent shows card added but banner "Accept billing terms to enable usage". They thought adding a card was enough.

noah (SDK): We currently passthrough the API 403. Quick win: map billing_required -> friendlier message in SDKs that suggests the admin action and includes a diagnostic link. I'll open a PR.

irene (Accounts): We intentionally require explicit acceptance for SSO orgs to prevent accidental billing. We can add clearer copy in the banner.

maya (DevEx): Short-term workaround for support replies: 1) ask admin to open Console -> Billing -> Accept terms, or 2) run `rwd workspace refresh --wait-billing` if they prefer CLI. Advise retry after ~15-30s.

noah (SDK): Also adding small client retry when token type == service-account and response indicates billing gating: 3 fast attempts with exponential backoff. That reduces the chance the user sees the failure while webhooks propagate. PR #5033.

deploy-bot: CI:deploy queued for branch quickstart-billing-fix (includes SDK message mapping + retry).

cami (Support): I'll draft KB article and canned reply with screenshot and CLI hint.

maya (DevEx): I'll update the quickstart README to include an "SSO onboarding" callout and the exact error text so users know it's billing gating, not an SDK bug.

irene (Accounts): Long-term idea: allow a limited trial token that bypasses explicit accept for low-risk orgs. Filing FR-299.

noah (SDK): PR merged to staging. Will monitor errors once deployed.

deploy-bot: Deploy succeeded: staging -> prod (v1.36.0). :white_check_mark:

maya (DevEx): Confirmed with reporter — after admin accepted terms their first call succeeded. Closing loop. :tada:
